in_marathi.name: Kavyanjali
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kavyanjali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit words ‘kavya’ (poetry) and ‘anjali’ (garland). It symbolizes the tradition of presenting a garland of verses to a deity or a revered person as an offering.
